protocol_metadata.about: Ember Protocol is a unified vault platform that tokenizes yield and fund strategies across DeFi, CeFi, and Web2. It is the first Structured Vaults Product on Sui, incubated by Bluewater Labs. The protocol offers non-custodial, permissionless vaults with strategies running across Sui, and expansion planned for Solana and EVM chains. Deposits are currently available on Sui with Ethereum deployment anticipated.
